nodes.label: Ember Portal Branding
nodes.rationale: Icon is a summoning circle rendered as pure energy, matching the app's ember accent (dark #FF9E2C, light #E8590C); SVG sources live in resources/ and PNGs are regenerated with rsvg-convert.

nodes.label: Webview Wrapper Architecture
nodes.rationale: Embed each service's official web app in a WebContentsView. Chosen over native protocol clients (only Telegram has an official personal API; reverse-engineered WhatsApp/Messenger/Discord libs violate ToS and risk account bans; Zalo has nothing) and hybrid TDLib+webviews (complexity for marginal gain).

nodes.label: Electron Desktop Shell Decision
nodes.rationale: Electron (latest stable) chosen over Tauri v2 (two webview engines to test, weaker multi-webview session isolation, some chat web apps degrade on non-Chrome engines) and CEF (too much plumbing); bundled Chromium gives identical rendering on macOS and Windows.

nodes.label: Per-Service Session Isolation
nodes.rationale: Each service gets a persistent partition (persist:<id>) so cookies, logins, and storage never bleed across services; login sessions survive restarts.

nodes.label: Chrome User-Agent Override
nodes.rationale: Strip the Electron/app tokens and present a current plain Chrome UA — required because WhatsApp Web and Google-family login flows block unknown user agents.

nodes.label: Service Hibernation
nodes.rationale: Destroys webContents of background services idle > N minutes (default 30) to mitigate RAM growth with five web apps; WhatsApp/Zalo default to never-hibernate because hibernated services cannot count unread or notify.

nodes.label: Unread Count Recipes
nodes.rationale: Small per-service DOM scripts adapted from ferdium-recipes (Apache-2.0) that extract {direct, indirect} unread counts on an interval; fixture-backed tests so a service redesign shows up as a red test, not a silently wrong badge.

nodes.label: Title-Parse Fallback / Stale Dot
nodes.rationale: If DOM badge selectors break, fall back to parsing '(N)' from the document title; if that also fails, show a neutral 'count may be stale' dot instead of a wrong number.

nodes.label: Unisolated Service Preload
nodes.rationale: Service preloads run with contextIsolation:false, sandbox:false, nodeIntegration:false because a context-isolated preload cannot wrap window.Notification — Ferdium's proven model for these exact services; the shell renderer keeps full context isolation.

nodes.label: Graphite Minimal Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark-first neutral surfaces with a single accent so the shell stays quiet and doesn't clash with embedded services' own UIs; rejected native vibrancy/Mica (finicky in Electron, two styling targets) and expressive/colorful direction. All text pairs meet WCAG AA.

nodes.label: Viber Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Viber has no web client at all (its desktop app is a native QR-paired client with nothing embeddable) and no ferdium recipe exists, so it is deliberately excluded from the five-service set.

nodes.label: ShellState Broadcast Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Main process is the single source of truth: it holds settings + runtime state and broadcasts a full ShellState snapshot to the renderer over typed IPC on every mutation; broadcast() is the single place where state fans out to rail badges, dock/overlay badges, and tray tooltip.

nodes.label: Tag-Push Release Flow
nodes.rationale: v* tag push -> matrix build -> GitHub Release with installers attached via softprops/action-gh-release. Rejected electron-builder built-in publishing (publish: github would leak publish behavior into local builds and produce draft releases with less control) and build-only artifacts (users would have to dig into Actions runs — fails the 'download directly' requirement).

nodes.label: Unsigned Builds Decision
nodes.rationale: No signing certificates exist; CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false skips mac signing cleanly in CI. Users bypass Gatekeeper (right-click -> Open) and SmartScreen (More info -> Run anyway) manually. Code signing/notarization deferred until distribution widens.

nodes.label: Version/Tag Match Guard
nodes.rationale: On tag runs, fail the build before packaging if the pushed tag does not equal 'v' + package.json version, so releases can never carry a mismatched version.

nodes.label: publish: null Policy
nodes.rationale: electron-builder.yml keeps publish: null so local packaging never publishes; CI additionally passes --publish never as belt-and-braces because electron-builder can auto-publish on CI tag builds when a token is present.

nodes.label: macOS Ad-hoc Signing (identity: '-')
nodes.rationale: macOS refuses Notification Center registration for unsigned bundles (notifications fail with UNErrorDomain 1 and no permission prompt appears), so mac builds are ad-hoc signed with identity '-' while remaining certificate-free.

nodes.label: pnpm allowBuilds allowlist
nodes.rationale: Only electron, electron-winstaller, and esbuild are allowed to run install-time build scripts under pnpm's script-blocking policy.

nodes.label: Shell renderer index.html
nodes.rationale: Strict CSP (default-src 'self'; inline styles and data: images only) for the shell chrome; embedded services render in separate WebContentsViews, not in this document.
